newsitem.title: GERMANY: German airlines assocation elects new chairman.
newsitem.headline: German airlines assocation elects new chairman.

text.p: The Board of Airline Representatives in Germany (Barig) said Joergen Moellegaard has been elected its new chairman.
Barig is a lobbying association representing 102 international and German airlines operating to and from Germany.

Moellegaard is Germany and Austria director of Scandinavian Airlines System, and was elected ahead of Werner Berghaus, Germany director of Varig and Wolfgang Gehring, Germany director of Continental Airlines.
He replaces Bernd Struck of United Airlines who will become Frankfurt airport head of passenger services in July.
